text:
alex_g: Heads-up — AtlasHealth POC kickoff tomorrow. Need to lock down the scoped use cases, acceptance criteria, and who owns the security questionnaire. They want an 8-week pilot, demo at week 6. 

maria_pm: TL;DR from BD: goal is reduce triage time for inbound patient messages and generate short clinician summaries. They want 2 endpoints: classification (triage level) and concise summarization (1-2 sentences). Prioritize classification first.

ben_se: For classification — what's expected QPS and latency SLO? Important for model choice (ggml/quant vs full fp16). Also: do they need contextual memory across messages?

alex_g: QPS ~ 3-5 reqs/s steady per tenant during pilot; spikes to ~12/s in peak hours. SLO ask from customer: 95th < 500ms ideally. We proposed can hit that on hosted with small Llama-2 13B quantized, or Dedicated with 2xA10 for <200ms.

maria_pm: Success criteria suggestions: 1) classification: >85% match to clinician labels on holdout set; 2) summarization: clinicians rate 4/5 usefulness on 50 evals; 3) latency: 95th < 500ms for classification; 4) integration: <1 dev-day for ingest endpoint.

olivia_re: Pricing question from procurement: can we offer a 2-month pilot discount and cap monthly spend to $10k? Also they asked if PII logs will be retained.

ben_se: Notes: for pilot cap $10k we should recommend hosted with conservative batching + prefix cache. If they need PII not retained, we can enable no-log mode + customer-managed encryption keys on Private. Dedicated is more expensive.

sarah_sec: I need the security questionnaire. Quick answers: SOC2? In progress, expected Q3. Encryption at rest/in transit: AES-256 / TLS1.2+. KMS support: yes for Private deployments. Will send questionnaire PDF — who should I copy?

alex_g: Copy me and olivia_re. Also need to confirm data residency — they require US-only. Will that block Hosted?

ben_se: US region only is fine for Hosted if we pin region. For Dedicated/Private it's trivial. Note: cross-region fallback must be disabled in routing policy for them.

maria_pm: Prioritization: 1) triage classification endpoint (must-have) 2) clinician summary (should-have) 3) multi-message context / timeline stitching (nice-to-have).

alex_g: Proposed minimal API contract for POC (stub):
```
POST /v1/atlas/trriage
Payload: { "patient_message": "string", "conversation_id": "string", "metadata": {"source":"portal"}}
Response: { "triage_level": "low|medium|high", "confidence": 0.0-1.0 }
```

ben_se: For evals: we should create a 200-sample labeled set for classification and 50 clinician-graded summaries. Use deterministic prompts and keep the same RNG seeds for reproducibility. I can export a small harness.

olivia_re: Confirming procurement: I asked for a written pilot quote. If they accept $10k cap, what do we include? Hosted generation + triage calls, 50k tokens/month, 1 support seat, and 2 model rollout tweaks.

alex_g: Sounds reasonable. Add an opt-in security review session with Sarah. Also propose weekly syncs: Mon 11am PST.

sarah_sec: I'll schedule a 1-hr call tomorrow to walk the questionnaire. Please upload their completed questionnaire to the secure folder and mark any fields that require redaction.

deploy-bot: Quote #Q-2026-178 created for AtlasHealth (pilot cap $10k) by olivia_re.

ben_se: Action items I have: build eval harness, share latency perf matrix for 13B vs 70B, run a small throughput sim with batching options. ETA: 48h.

maria_pm: I'm owner for success criteria and clinician evals. Will pull 50 sample cases and coordinate clinicians. ETA: 5 business days.

olivia_re: I'll circulate the procurement note and get signature window. ETA: 2 business days.

alex_g: Great. Next steps: ben_se and sarah_sec to sync on data handling before harness runs. We will confirm the final acceptance tests by Friday. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
